AA smallcases · final rule backtest · four books · signal at Friday close, trade Monday at OHLC4

Three indices must agree for equity; otherwise gold and cash, weighted by MCX gold's trend

Each AA book is shown against its parent smallcase and the live AA as it actually traded. Pick a book and a period. Every chart, table and holding below comes from the same backtest the Excel workbook reproduces.

Live window 2021-11 → 2026-08, plus the parents' real baskets 2014-07 → 2021-10 · every signal from the desk's production ST.py on weekly candles: Nifty 100, Midcap 100, Smallcap 100 and MAUc1 (MCX gold futures) · stocks filled at the Monday OHLC4, GOLDBEES at the Monday OHLC4 with ETF-only spikes clipped · 20.8 bps round trip · workbook: AA/analysis/evidence/final_strategy/final_strategy_workbook_mauc1.xlsx

1 · EquityHold the whole parent portfolio while Nifty 100, Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 are all BUY on the weekly supertrend.
2 · SleeveIf any of the three is SELL, move the whole book to gold (GOLDBEES) and cash (LBES).
3 · SplitInside the sleeve, 80% GOLDBEES / 20% cash if the weekly supertrend of MAUc1 (MCX gold futures) is BUY; 20% / 80% if it is SELL. Re-checked each week while in the sleeve. Before MAUc1's first signal (2015-03-13) the sleeve holds 50/50.
4 · TimingSignals at Friday's close; trades on the next session (Monday, or Tuesday after a holiday) at (open+high+low+close)/4. For GOLDBEES, open, high and low are first pulled into its close ± (MCX gold's range that day + 0.5%). No trade while the target is unchanged.
